## Fix now — bugs and runaway risks

### 1. `selectRepo` kills the live session even when the repo did not change
**STATUS: DONE** — selectRepo now normalises through gitRoot and early-returns when unchanged
**Files:** `src/App.tsx:190-196` (+ callers `App.tsx:417-426`, `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:174`)
**Why:** Ctrl+P → Enter (or clicking the repo header you are already in) bumps `chatGeneration`, remounts ChatPane, and `claudeStop`s the in-flight turn with no confirmation — and the empty-query top entry is *always* the repo you are currently working in, because it sorts by newest session activity.
**Change:** Early-return in `selectRepo` when `gitRoot(path)` equals `activeRepo` (raw `group.cwd` from `sessions.rs:584` is unnormalised, so a bare string compare misses the sidebar path); only clear resume state when the repo actually changes; when ChatPane reports `running`, confirm before remounting.

### 2. Permission-mode dropdown silently destroys a fresh session
**STATUS: DONE** — permissionModeRef holds the spawn-time value; the select shows a pending state
**Files:** `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:266, 306-310, 341, 357, 372, 727-728`
**Why:** `permissionMode` sits in the `start` useCallback deps and the lifecycle effect depends on `start`, so picking a mode tears down the child and clears the transcript on the spot — the opposite of its own tooltip ("applies on restart") — and a fresh chat respawns with `resume === null`, i.e. a brand-new session id.
**Change:** Hold the spawn-time value in `permissionModeRef`, set it in the select's `onChange` alongside display state, read `permissionModeRef.current` at `:341`, drop `permissionMode` from the dep array at `:357`; mark the select "pending" when it differs from the live process. Pair with resuming from a `sessionIdRef` (updated in `handleFrame` near `:388`) so the explicit Restart button re-attaches instead of forking.

### 3. Session status dots lie: synthetic user records and a sticky interrupt flag
**STATUS: DONE** — isSyntheticEcho ported; interrupted cleared on assistant turns; watermark gated
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:337-343, 344-367, 368-374`
**Why:** Every `type == "user"` record — `<command-name>` echoes, `<\task-notification>`, `<ide_opened_file>` — counts as a conversational turn, and the assistant arm never clears `inputs.interrupted`, so finished sessions read "active" then "interrupted" (7 historical episodes, median 137 min; 1 session on disk right now).
**Change:** Port `isSyntheticEcho` (`jsonlParser.ts:802`) and `continue` before the timestamp fold at `:337`; add `inputs.interrupted = false;` at the top of the assistant arm (`jsonlParser.ts:183`). Both must land together or session `5143ae70` still misreads. While in the function, gate `ended_at_ms` on the liveness whitelist (user / assistant / queue-operation / system∈{api_error, model_refusal_fallback}) — hardening, but it is the same edit.

### 4. Ctrl+B narrows the sidebar once and is then inert
**STATUS: DONE** — leftCollapsed state replaces the delta hack
**Files:** `src/App.tsx:72, 216-219, 281, 291`
**Why:** `resizeLeft(leftWidth > 60 ? -leftWidth + 40 : 260)` feeds a delta into a setter clamped to `[160,700]`, so press 1 pins 160, every later press recomputes 160, and the `: 260` restore branch is provably dead — the most-used VSCode chord does nothing.
**Change:** Add `leftCollapsed` state (mirroring the existing `terminalVisible` pattern at `App.tsx:88, 203-207`), render `width: leftCollapsed ? 0 : leftWidth` plus matching flex basis, skip the `Resizer` while collapsed, and match `"b" || "B"`. Do **not** persist a 0 width — `Split.tsx:61` rejects it and silently resets to 300.

### 5. Light-mode and system-dark colour bugs (one CSS pass)
**STATUS: DONE** — all colours tokenised across three palette blocks; ungated scrollbar rule deleted
**Files:** `src/styles.css:79-82, 423-429, 525, 828, 972, 1052-1053`
**Why:** Six hardcoded hexes outside the palette blocks, two of them unreadable: the selected session row's meta line is 1.30:1 in light mode, the usage track is invisible, and the ungated `:root:not([data-theme="dark"]) ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb` paints a 20%-black thumb on the **default** system-dark background (~1.06:1) while also out-specifying `:hover`.
**Change:** Add `--chip-bg/-fg`, `--chip-head-bg/-fg`, `--status-idle`, `--track`, `--meta-selected`, `--scrollbar-thumb/-hover` to all three palette blocks (`:root`, `[data-theme="light"]`, the media block at `:56`); delete the `:79-82` rule; use `color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 78%, var(--bg-active))` for the meta line (deleting it regresses dark to 3.52:1). Fix the now-false comment at `:78`.

### 6. Error `result` frames show no failure mode
**STATUS: DONE** — error result text rendered, failure-only
**Files:** `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:48, 448, 660-669`
**Why:** `item.text` holds the error subtype (`error_max_turns`, `error_max_budget_usd`, `error_during_execution`) but is never rendered, and those subtypes produce no stderr and no process exit, so the stderr/exit handlers do not cover them — you get a bare red "error · 3 turns · $0.04".
**Change:** Render `item.text` under the `who` line **only when `item.isError`**, `var(--red)`, selectable. Do not add an "!= success" fallback — on success `frame.result` is the full final answer and would duplicate it. Optionally declare `errors?: string[]` / `terminal_reason` on `ClaudeFrame` (`src/lib/types.ts:110-129`) and join them in.

### 7. `claude_send` holds the global chat-map lock across a blocking pipe write
**STATUS: DONE** — chat map lock released before the pipe write
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/claude.rs:257-263, 272, 294, 306, 321-331, 346`
**Why:** These are sync commands, so they run inline on the GTK main loop; a pasted screenshot (base64 PNG up to 1568px, `primary.rs:81-125`) past the ~128KB pipe+highWaterMark budget parks the write, freezing the entire window — and because `stop_chat` and `claude_status` take the same lock, the chat becomes unkillable from the UI.
**Change:** Clone the `Arc<Mutex<ChildStdin>>` out of the map, drop the map guard, then write (the per-chat stdin mutex still serialises frames). Better: a per-chat writer thread fed by a bounded channel, which preserves order. Also gate `send()`/`onKeyDown` (`ChatPane.tsx:516-565`) on `running`, not just `alive`.

### 8. Terminal colours: ANSI black == background, no bright ramp, no repaint on OS theme flip
**STATUS: DONE** — full 16-colour ramp + minimumContrastRatio + OS-flip listener
**Files:** `src/panes/TerminalPane.tsx:27-43, 78-86, 231-238`; `src/styles.css` palette blocks; `src/App.tsx:382`
**Why:** `black: background` makes `ESC[30m` invisible in *both* themes, the eight bright slots silently keep xterm's Tango ramp (brightWhite `#eeeeec` = 1.09:1 on white), `minimumContrastRatio` is never set, and under the default `system` theme flipping the desktop repaints the whole app via CSS while the canvas keeps its stale palette — recoverable only by restarting or remounting, which `ptyClose`s the shell.
**Change:** Add `--term-black/-white/-bright-*` tokens per palette block (Dark+ / Light+ ramps) and read all 16 in `readTheme()`; subscribe to `matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")` inside TerminalPane and re-run `term.options.theme = readTheme()` on `change` as well as on `themeKey` (keeps the rAF deferral, avoids an App-wide re-render).

### 9. Chat transcript and `toolResults` grow without bound
**STATUS: DONE** — transcript capped at 1500 items; consecutive system lines coalesced
**Files:** `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:299-301, 307, 428-437, 478-481, 611-680`; `src-tauri/src/claude.rs:218-230`
**Why:** `appendItem` never caps, `toolResults` retains the full text of every tool result (whole file reads, grep dumps) for the session's life, and stderr is one item per line with no batching — memory is unbounded and every append re-reconciles the whole unvirtualized list plus a forced layout.
**Change:** Cap `items` at ~1500 with a "…earlier messages trimmed" header; evict `toolResults` entries whose `tool_use_id` is no longer retained; coalesce consecutive stderr lines into one growing item (cheapest fix, kills the flood case). Treat `content-visibility: auto` as a later measured change — it breaks select-all, which `src/lib/primary.ts:55` publishes to X11 PRIMARY.

### 10. Blocking I/O commands run on the GTK main loop
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:67-105`; `usage.rs:94-102`; `git.rs:50-60`; `workspace.rs:120-168`; `sessions.rs:613-620`
**Why:** Every registered command is a plain sync `fn`, which Tauri runs inline inside the WebKitGTK uri-scheme callback — so a black-holed usage endpoint freezes the whole window for up to 15s every 5 minutes (and ureq 2's timeout does not cover DNS), and every git query / transcript open stalls input and repaint.
**Change:** Convert `fetch_usage`, `git_*`, `search_files`, `read_text_file`, `list_dir`, `discover_repos`, `read_session_transcript`, `list_sessions` to `async fn` whose body runs in `tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking`. Do **not** use bare `#[tauri::command(async)]` — that blocks a tokio *worker*, not the blocking pool. See conflict C1.

### 11. Kill the CLI's process group and reap it
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/claude.rs:139, 142-149, 206, 321-331`; `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` (no exit handler)
**Why:** `stop_chat` SIGKILLs the bare pid with no `wait()`, and the child shares the app's process group, so every restart (Restart button, cwd change, permission-mode change, twice per pane under StrictMode) orphans stdio MCP servers and Bash-tool descendants to init and leaves a zombie; quitting the app leaks the whole tree.
**Change:** `#[cfg(unix)] .process_group(0)` at spawn; in `stop_chat` drop `ChildStdin` first (stdin EOF), then off the lock: `kill(-pgid, SIGTERM)` → short grace → `SIGKILL` → `waitpid`. Add `libc` to `Cargo.toml` (0.2.189 already in `Cargo.lock:2183`) and run the same teardown on app exit. Skip the pty half — portable-pty already setsids and `pty.rs:152` reaps.

## Parity wins

### 12. Stream partial assistant text
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/claude.rs:10-16, 104-129, 165-212`; `src/lib/ipc.ts`; `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:403-421, 455-457`
**Why:** A long thinking block plus a long answer is a single assistant message, so it materialises atomically after tens of seconds behind a static "working…" — you can interrupt but cannot decide to. This is the largest felt gap from the `claude` CLI.
**Change:** Add `--include-partial-messages` behind a setting; coalesce in the Rust stdout loop keyed on `(parent_tool_use_id, index)` so subagent sidechains (which restart at index 0) do not bleed in, clear on `message_start`, take only `text_delta`/`thinking_delta`, flush at ~50ms and on `content_block_stop`/`message_stop`, emit one `claude://delta` and swallow the raw frames. Render as a trailing pseudo-item cleared when the settled frame lands. **Architectural:** breaks the "interpret nothing here" invariant at `claude.rs:14-16` — update that comment.

### 13. Ctrl+P is a repo switcher; `search_files` has zero call sites
**Files:** `src/panes/QuickOpen.tsx:28-45, 64, 87, 104-107, 117, 123`; `src/App.tsx:212-215, 253-257, 417-426`; `src-tauri/src/workspace.rs:119-168`; `src/lib/ipc.ts:107`; `src/panes/Settings.tsx:81`
**Why:** The VSCode reflex "Ctrl+P, filename, Enter" returns "No matching repo.", there is no way anywhere to open a file by name, and a finished gitignore-aware backend search ships unreachable; Ctrl+Shift+P falls into the same branch because it only tests `event.key === "P"`.
**Change:** Make QuickOpen mode-aware — no prefix + active repo = `searchFiles(activeRepo, query, 60)` debounced ~80ms → `onOpenFile`; `>` = command palette; repo switcher on explicit prefix / Ctrl+R / when no repo is active. Gate the Ctrl+P branch on `!event.shiftKey` (Caps Lock is safe) and route Ctrl+Shift+P to the palette. Note `search_files` is substring-only — swap in a subsequence score before calling it fuzzy — and relabel the two UI strings that call Ctrl+P the repo switcher.

### 14. Answer `control_request` / `can_use_tool` so `default` permission mode works
**Files:** `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:455-458`; `src-tauri/src/claude.rs:104-129, 126-128`; `src/panes/Settings.tsx:14, 68-70`
**Why:** Nothing inbound is handled and no `--permission-prompt-tool` is passed, so `default` mode silently auto-denies every ask-gated Edit/Write/Bash (the Settings hint saying it "stalls" is also wrong) — the workbench can only run with weaker safety than the terminal it replaces.
**Change:** *Same commit:* add `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` (hidden flag, verified in CLI 2.1.238; skip it if `extra_args` already sets one) **and** a `case "control_request"` rendering tool name + input + Allow / Allow-for-session / Deny, replying via `claudeSendRaw` with `{type:"control_response",response:{subtype:"success",request_id,response:{behavior:"allow",updatedPermissions?}|{behavior:"deny",message}}}`; track outstanding ids for `control_cancel_request`. **Today, cheaply:** drop `default` from the dropdown or label it "auto-denies". **Architectural:** introduces a request/response lifecycle into a fire-and-forget pane.

### 15. Tab strip has no mouse or keyboard conventions
**Files:** `src/App.tsx:22-25, 130-161, 200-223, 294-317`; `src/styles.css:765, 785-792`
**Why:** Closing needs an invisible hover-only ×, there is no Ctrl+W / Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+1..9 / middle-click, and every single click from the tree or a tool block pins a permanent tab, so browsing twenty files leaves twenty tabs scrolling sideways.
**Change:** Add `onAuxClick` (button 1 → `closeTab`, with `onMouseDown` preventDefault to kill WebKitGTK autoscroll); bind Ctrl+W / Ctrl+PageUp-Down / Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+1..9 in the App handler — but first add the `event.target` and modal guards it lacks, since `ChatPane.tsx:556` does not stop propagation (xterm already does, via `cancel(e, true)`). Add `preview: boolean` to the file/diff variants: single click replaces the preview tab, double-click pins. Keep the active tab's × always visible. Skip dirty state — the viewer is read-only.

### 16. `pendingReview` overlay and a seen store
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:250-311, 475-479, 564-568`; `src/lib/types.ts:10-15`; new `src/lib/seen.ts`; `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:209`; `src/panes/StatusPanel.tsx:120-128, 183`; `src/styles.css:501-524`
**Why:** Every clean end is "finished", so the pane cannot tell "done and I read it" from "done, needs review" — the state most sessions on a multi-repo machine sit in — and StatusPanel's "N done" carries no signal.
**Change:** Export the conversational watermark as `lastActivityMs` (already computed at `:475-479`; set it on the cache-hit path at `:564-568` too — do **not** reuse `modifiedMs`, which flipped reviewed sessions back). Persist `{watermark, seenAt, unread}` in localStorage (this app has no cross-window shard problem the reference solves). Overlay in the frontend: finished → pendingReview unless `seenWatermark >= lastActivityMs && !markedUnread`. Mark seen at `max(lastActivityMs, Date.now())` on attach; add mark-unread and a sixth dot colour.

### 17. `ai-title` missed outside the 128KB tail; row labels churn
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:447-451, 552-556`; `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:215`; `src/panes/StatusPanel.tsx:189`
**Why:** 8 of 147 local transcripts wrote their `ai-title` once, early, and never regenerated it, so those rows fall back to `lastPrompt` and rewrite their label on every turn — exactly the churn the reference refuses (`sessionTreeProvider.ts:110-115`).
**Change:** On cache miss, add a dedicated pass: read the file and take the last line containing the byte substring `"type":"ai-title"`, JSON-parsing only that line (84ms for the whole 177MB corpus, 1.9ms for the largest file, against a 1500ms debounce). Drop `lastPrompt` from the label chain so untitled sessions show a stable short id. Widening the head to 256KB does not work — one title sits at offset 333,347.

### 18. Stop a sessions rescan and a splitter drag from re-rendering the whole workbench
**Files:** `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:50-71, 18-24, 219`; `src/App.tsx:72-80, 120, 223, 281-282, 329-338, 358-360, 365, 392`; `src/layout/Split.tsx:24-32, 45, 61-71`
**Why:** Both paths write App state on every event — a fresh array per scan (roughly every 375ms while claude streams, because the debouncer ticks at timeout/4 and flushes aged events rather than resetting) and a `setSize` + `localStorage` write per pointer sample — and with zero `React.memo` in the repo each one reconciles the unvirtualized chat transcript, so cost scales with conversation length.
**Change:** (a) Keep the last scan in a ref and bail before `setGroups`/`onGroups` when a full signature matches — include size, not just `modifiedMs`, since the Rust cache invalidates on mtime **and** size; drive `shortAge` from a pane-local tick so relative ages do not freeze. (b) Wrap `ChatPane` in `React.memo` (all props at `App.tsx:329-338` are already primitives or stable callbacks). (c) Drive drags through a CSS custom property held in a ref, commit `setSize` once on `pointerup`/`pointercancel`, duplicate the clamp in the drag path, bump `refitToken` on release, and move the keydown handler's `leftWidth` read into a ref. **Architectural (optional):** report the changed path per watcher event and refresh one session, as `watcher.ts:42` → `extension.ts:88-92` does.

## Later

### 19. Per-session tokens, cost and live context
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:46-69, 425-497`; `src/lib/types.ts:18-33`; `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:218-231`
**Why:** `read_session` never reads `message.usage`, so for every session except the one attached to the chat pane there is no spend, no cross-repo total, and no "this one is at 180k, /compact first" signal.
**Change:** Ship `last_context_tokens` first — exact from the tail alone (`None`, not 0, when the tail has no usage record). Accumulate tokens/cost over `tail` **only** (the 32KB head overlaps it below 128KB and would double-count), dedup by `message.id`, expose behind a `tokens_exact` flag rendered "48+". Price against the newest non-`<synthetic>` model, not `SessionMeta.model`. **Architectural if exact sums are wanted:** needs the reference's incremental byte-offset resume — a full-file pass would turn today's 160KB sample into a 1.5MB read several times a second while streaming.

### 20. Resume history limit counts raw JSONL lines
**Files:** `src/panes/ChatPane.tsx:54, 320`; `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:612-624`
**Why:** ~37% of the 400-record budget is spent on `attachment` / `queue-operation` / `ai-title` records that render nothing, and nothing tells the user scrollback was cut — filtering first would give ~1.6x deeper history for the same cost.
**Change:** In `read_session_transcript`, filter to `type` ∈ {user, assistant} before applying `limit` (tool_result echoes are `type: "user"` and must be kept — they are what makes tool output visible on resume), return the dropped count, always keep the first surviving record plus the tail, and render "… N earlier records omitted" with a "load earlier" control. One caller, whole file already read — no extra I/O.

### 21. Redundant sidechain probe
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/sessions.rs:207-243, 480, 569-575`
**Why:** The probe at `:480` computes a status thrown away twenty lines later at `:574`, and unlike `:569` it has no 24h guard, so a cold scan probes all 147 transcripts to discard 125 results — cheap to delete, and it scales with subagent count (one session here has 88 agent logs).
**Change:** Pass 0 for `sidechain_ms` in `read_session` and let `:569-575` own liveness (cold-start drops from 147 probes over 511 logs to 22 over ~110). Then gate the surviving probe on the only cases `classify` reads it: `clean_end && queue_depth <= 0`, or `tool_in_flight && age > TOOL_RUNNING_GRACE_MS`. A probe TTL is optional and near-useless against a 15s poll already debounced to 1500ms — size it to the debounce, not the poll.

### 22. Command registry as one source of truth for actions
**Files:** `src/App.tsx:200-223, 251-277`; `src/panes/FileTree.tsx:94-99`; `src/panes/SessionsPane.tsx:195`
**Why:** New session, resume session, refresh tree, show dotfiles and reveal file have no keyboard path at all, and the titlebar/pane buttons each own their own handler.
**Change:** Introduce `{id, title, keybinding, run}` entries that the palette (entry 13), the titlebar buttons and the pane-header buttons all dispatch through. **Architectural:** cross-cutting refactor of the keymap and every button call site — do it only after entry 13 lands, or the palette has nothing to list.

## Architectural, not local edits

- **12 (streaming deltas):** new IPC event, a live-block model in ChatPane, and a deliberate breach of the `claude.rs` "forward verbatim" invariant.
- **14 (`can_use_tool`):** adds a bidirectional control-protocol layer, a new `ChatItem` kind, and per-request lifecycle state to a currently fire-and-forget pane.
- **10 (async commands):** changes every command signature and how state is captured (`spawn_blocking` + `Send` bounds).
- **11 (process groups):** new `libc` dependency, changed spawn flags, and an app-exit teardown hook that does not exist today.
- **19 (exact token sums):** requires porting the reference's incremental byte-offset transcript cache; the tail-only variant is the local edit.
- **18c (per-path watcher events):** changing `sessions://changed` to carry the changed path means a per-file refresh API in `sessions.rs` and a different store shape in `SessionsPane`.
- **22 (command registry):** cross-cutting.

## Conflicts and ordering constraints

- **C1 — 10 vs 7.** Entry 10 says "move blocking commands off the main thread", but `pty_write`, `claude_send`, `claude_send_raw` and `claude_interrupt` must be **excluded**: `TerminalPane.tsx:103` fires `void ptyWrite(...)` from `term.onData` un-awaited, and inline single-threaded execution is currently the only thing guaranteeing keystroke order. Spawning them lets two writes race for the non-FIFO mutex at `pty.rs:120` and scramble input. Fix those with entry 7's bounded queue + ordered writer thread instead.
- **C2 — 14 is atomic.** Adding `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` without the `control_request` handler converts today's silent auto-deny into a real hang. Never ship half.
- **C3 — 18a vs relative ages.** The scan bail-out freezes `shortAge` until some field moves; either fold a coarse age bucket into the signature or drive age from a pane-local tick. Also note 18a's signature must include size, or a same-millisecond append is missed.
- **C4 — 9 vs 20.** Capping `items` and evicting `toolResults` interacts with the resume hydrate path: evict only entries whose `tool_use_id` no longer appears in a retained item, and re-fetch (not re-cap) when "load earlier" is used.
- **C5 — 18b vs 9's memo proposal.** `React.memo(ChatPane)` is safe, but memoizing the *row* must not take the whole `toolResults` map as a prop — that invalidates every assistant row on every tool result and defeats the memo. Pass only the resolved values for that row's ids.
- **C6 — 13 supersedes part of 1.** Making Ctrl+P a file finder removes the common path into the destructive `selectRepo`, but ship entry 1's guard first: the repo header in SessionsPane reaches it independently.
- **C7 — 3 before the watermark whitelist.** The "non-synthetic user" half of the `ended_at_ms` gate is not implementable until `isSyntheticEcho` is ported; gate on all user records or land them together.
- **C8 — 5, one resolved trap.** For `.session-row[data-selected="true"] .meta-line`, use the `color-mix` form; deleting the rule to inherit `--fg-dim` fixes light (4.06:1) but regresses dark to 3.52:1, failing AA at 10px.
